tool.name: alevin-fry generate permit list
tool.description: of barcodes from a RAD file
tool.command: mkdir input && ln -s '$input_rad' input/map.rad && mkdir output && alevin-fry generate-permit-list --input input --expected-ori '$expected_ori' --output-dir output #if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'knee-distance': --knee-distance #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'force-cells': --force-cells $barcode.force_ncells #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'valid-bc': --valid-bc '$barcode.bcfile' #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'unfiltered-pl': --unfiltered-pl '$barcode.plist' --min-reads $barcode.min_reads #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'expect-cells': --expect-cells $barcode.expect_ncells #end if #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.multi_barcode_mode_select == 'yes': --sample-bc-list $sec_advanced_options.sample_bc_list #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_names: --sample-names $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_names #end if #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_correction_mode == 'exact': --sample-correction-mode exact #else if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_correction_mode == '1-edit': --sample-correction-mode 1-edit #end if #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_bc_ori == 'forward': --sample-bc-ori forward #else if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_bc_ori == 'reverse': --sample-bc-ori reverse #end if #end if && mkdir -p '$output_dir.extra_files_path/permit_list' && mv output/* '$output_dir.extra_files_path/permit_list'

param.name: force_ncells
param.label: Number of barcodes to keep
param.help: This amount of the most frequent barcodes will be considered part of the permit list.

param.name: bcfile
param.label: List of true, filtered barcodes
param.help: Barcodes in this list will be considered to correspond to true and filtered cells for this sample.

param.name: plist
param.label: Unfiltered barcode permit list
param.help: List of possible barcodes for the sample, e.g. an external permit list like the 10x v2 or the 10x v3.

param.label: Minimum reads
param.help: Only barcodes occuring at least this many times are retained and considered as present cells.

param.name: expect_ncells
param.label: Expected number of cells
param.help: Value around which a robust cutoff will be chosen.

param.label: Sample barcode list
param.help: File containing known sample/library barcodes (one per line).

param.label: Sample names
param.help: TSV file mapping sample barcodes to human-readable names. One line per barcode/name combination, with the barcode and name separated by a tab.

param.label: Sample correction mode
param.help: Correction mode for sample barcodes. Default value: exact.

param.label: Sample barcode orientation
param.help: Orientation of sample barcodes in the whitelist relative to the read. Default value: forward. Forward = whitelist matches read as-is. Reverse = reverse-complement the whitelist before lookup, e.g. 10x Flex v2.
